nodes.line: Been here since before it was like this. Go on.

Do not laugh. I am sending back 49 papers a day from Douglas Park and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Do not let them talk you into anything.

It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. They will drop my Douglas Park order if I can show $153 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the Sunday after payday. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. There's cash in it. Not a lot.
Take a breath. Then say the whole thing.

npcs.name: Zofia, paper runner at Douglas Park

nodes.line: Do not mind the mess. It is structural now.

Two people have already said no. I do the Douglas Park round from first light and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. You'll know it when you see it.

Someone has to, and it may as well be you. There is a dog on the Douglas Park round that has had two of my bags and a docket book that was not even mine. I am aware how that sounds. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.
Go on then. What did you find.

Not being dramatic about this. The agency at Menangle closed six months before Douglas Park started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I would rather know than wonder.
You came back. That already puts you ahead.

nodes.line: You right there? I am mid-something but go on.
